research.facts:
USA WNT — ONE DAY to Devon Park
**Verified Facts (HIGH confidence):**
- WBSC Women's Softball World Cup Group Oklahoma: Devon Park, Oklahoma City, Sept. 12–16
- USA (No. 2) opener vs. Mexico (No. 7): Sept. 12 at 7:30 PM ET
- Netherlands (No. 6) is the round-robin top-seed decider for USA
- Six-nation field: USA, Netherlands, Mexico, China, New Zealand, Brazil
- Top 2 advance to 2027 Finals in Redcliffe, QLD, April 5–11 (LA28 qualifier)
- Play-off bracket Sept. 16: 1st vs. 2nd (1 PM, direct finals), 3rd vs. 4th (4 PM), Repechage (7 PM)
- USA went 5-0 at the International Cup at Devon Park (same venue)
- Head coach: Patty Gasso; assistants: JT Gasso, Jennifer Rocha
- 16-player roster includes Rachel Garcia and Dejah Mulipola (2020 Olympians)
- 7 World Games gold medalists on roster
- Sooners on roster: Alyssa Brito, Jayda Coleman, Tiare Jennings, Kelly Maxwell
- Gasso, JT Gasso, Rocha depart Norman for OKC today/tomorrow (Sept. 11–12)
**Source:** usasoftball.com, soonersports.com, justwomenssports.com (via WebSearch)
